description: Source code for Zephyr OS shell commands related to filesystem operations, including mounting, directory navigation, file manipulation, and testing.

methods.name: create_abs_path
methods.description: Creates an absolute path from a given name, considering current working directory.

methods.name: cmd_cd
methods.description: Changes current working directory based on user input.

methods.name: cmd_ls
methods.description: Lists files and directories in the specified or current directory.

methods.name: cmd_trunc
methods.description: Truncates or extends a file to a specified length.

methods.name: cmd_mkdir
methods.description: Creates a new directory at specified path.

methods.name: cmd_read
methods.description: Reads and displays contents of a file.

methods.name: cmd_cat
methods.description: Concatenates and outputs contents of multiple files.

methods.name: cmd_write
methods.description: Writes data to a file, with optional offset.

methods.name: cmd_read_test
methods.description: Performs repeated read tests on a file to measure performance.

methods.name: cmd_erase_write_test
methods.description: Performs repeated erase and write tests on a file to measure performance.

methods.name: mntpt_prepare
methods.description: Prepares a mount point string for mounting filesystems.

methods.name: cmd_mount_fat
methods.description: Mounts FAT filesystem at specified mount point.

methods.name: cmd_mount_littlefs
methods.description: Mounts LittleFS filesystem at specified mount point.
